description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Enfeebling)

Benefit: As long as you have an enfeebling spell of 3rd level or higher in your known spells and have at least 3 MP in your MP pool, you can cloud the mind of a creature within 30 feet as a standard action, giving it a -2 penalty on its next attack roll or Reflex saving throw. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting enfeebling spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 3rd-level spells, Spell Focus (Enfeebling)
